name: pmitz
description: Add subscription plans, feature access and usage limits to an application with Pmitz, on your own server or in a sandbox.

pmitz_base_url.title: Pmitz server URL
pmitz_base_url.description: Base URL of your own Pmitz server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080. Leave empty if you only use the skill or a sandbox.

pmitz_api_key.title: Pmitz API key
pmitz_api_key.description: API key of that Pmitz server. It is sent only to the server URL above.

pmitz_read_only.title: Read-only mode
pmitz_read_only.description: Turn on to offer only the tools that read. Leave off to let the assistant also create products and subscriptions and change usage, after it asks you.
